fee_notes: License Fee (royalty) is 8% of Gross Sales for first 18 months; from month 19 onward, the greater of 8% of Gross Sales or $2,000/month minimum. MAP Fee is greater of 2% of Gross Sales or minimum MAP Fee: no minimum for first 18 months, $625/month for months 1-18 (per chart reference), $845/month thereafter; minimum may increase up to 30% annually. Customer Care Center Fee is 5% of Gross Sales (paid to affiliate Neighborly Service Solutions SPV LLC). Local Marketing Groups fee capped at 3% of Gross Sales, currently $400/month with 6-month waiver for new franchisees. Software System Fee is $303.49/month base with optional add-ons ($5.50-$30/month email accounts, $20-$40/month portal users, $12/month Tableau extra license, $30-$220/month QuickBooks Online). Separate 'Roll-In' sales fee schedule referenced but not fully detailed in excerpt.
raw_excerpt: License Fee1, 2 (a) 8% of Gross Sales for the first 18 months immediately following the opening of the Franchised Business, and (b) beginning in the 19th month of operation of the Franchised Business, the greater of (i) 8% of Gross Sales; or (ii) $2,000 per month ("Minimum License Fee"). MAP Fee1, 2, 3,4 The greater of (i) 2% of Gross Sales or (ii) Minimum MAP Fee (if applicable). The current Minimum MAP fee is $625 per month for the first 18 months following the Effective Date of the Franchise Agreement and $845 per month for each month thereafter. Customer Care Center Fee1, 2 5% of Gross Sales. Software System Fees1 $303.49 per month, plus: Additional Microsoft Office365 Exchange, E1 and E3 email accounts are available at $5.50 - $30/month depending on type of email account. Additional Franchise Portal User Accounts are available at $20 - $40/month. Additional access rights to the Tableau data warehouse (beyond the first license) may be granted for an additional $12/month or $144/year. If you obtain QuickBooks Online through ZorWare, you will pay an additional fee of $30-$220 per month depending on the license tier that you select. Local Marketing Groups1, 2, 3,4 Not to exceed 3% of Gross Sales; currently $400/month (and currently new franchisees receive a 6-month waiver of this fee).
